input.quote: Garman agrees to indemnify Sparkling and hold it harmless from any and all losses, damages and expenses including without limitation, court costs, arbitration fees, penalties, fines, amounts paid in settlement of claims and reasonable legal fees and expenses of investigation (collectively the "Losses") which Sparkling or any of its respective officers or directors may incur due to a breach of this warranty. Sparkling shall notify Garman in writing of any such claim within ten calendar days of a responsible officer of Sparkling becoming aware of such claim.
input.rationale: Section 13 contains only an indemnity for breach of Garman's title/non-infringement warranty: there is no express duty to defend or settlement-control mechanic, no coverage for Garman's breach of law, data incidents or gross negligence/wilful misconduct, no extension to our affiliates, and notice is a strict ten-calendar-day condition. The remedies (procure/modify/replace) are acceptable and Section 15 already carves Section 13 out of the liability cap; there is no reciprocal Customer indemnity to narrow. Redline adds defence/notice/cooperation procedure and the standard additional heads of Vendor indemnity, with a 3x annual fees super-cap available as fallback.

proposal.summary: Add Garman defence obligation and broaden its indemnity (IP, breach of law, data incidents, gross negligence/wilful misconduct); soften the 10-day notice condition.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 13 currently gives us only a warranty-breach indemnity with no duty to defend and a strict ten-day notice condition, so we have added an express defence and settlement-control mechanic with prompt (materially-prejudiced) notice and cooperation. We have also added the standard heads of vendor indemnity — third-party IP infringement, breach of applicable law, unauthorized access to our data, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct; if helpful, we can accept these additional heads subject to a super-cap of 3x annual fees.

ops.oldText: Sparkling shall notify Garman in writing of any such claim within ten calendar days of a responsible officer of Sparkling becoming aware of such claim.
ops.newText: Garman shall defend, at its own expense, any such claim brought against Sparkling and shall pay all damages and costs finally awarded or agreed in settlement, provided that Garman shall not settle any claim in a manner that imposes any obligation, liability or admission on Sparkling without Sparkling's prior written consent. Sparkling shall notify Garman in writing of any such claim promptly after a responsible officer of Sparkling becomes aware of such claim (provided that any failure or delay in giving notice shall relieve Garman of its obligations only to the extent Garman is materially prejudiced thereby) and shall provide reasonable cooperation at Garman's expense.

ops.text: In addition, Garman shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Sparkling and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting Losses, to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Work or the Maintenance Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right of any Person; (ii) Garman's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Sparkling's data caused by Garman; or (iv) Garman's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The notice, defence and cooperation procedures set out above shall apply to such claims.
